svg.text: ARMED. Ball on the bar, drape hung.
Drape down, bar flat. Ball rolling.
Landed. Rolls on down the lane after the group.
K Kabuki release: handle to all 6 pins (taut).
B Bar release: handle to both latch arms, 2" slack.
R Bar reset: bar ring to cleat (slack in show).
H Hoist + trip line: reload only, never in show.
L1, L2 Batten lift lines: fly out to stops, cleat.
1/4" braided polyester line, black. Pulleys: 1 1/2" single
blocks on screw eyes or eye bolts. Handle travel about 6":
K frees the drape in the first 3", B frees the bar after 5".
Test the pull 20 times before any show (A-8).
GYM HAUNTED HOUSE: HIDDEN BALL DROP (GROUP 4)
Scale: section frames 3/16 in = 1 ft; rigging not to scale (on a 17 x 11 in sheet)
Planning sketch: verify every dimension on site before cutting.
